title: Minstrel show parades and showdown rehearsals
summary: On reel 4, he recalls playing one advertising parade for a minstrel show, later the parades were cut and only the show remained after three weeks of rehearsal.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I'll start again if you're ready. This is Reel 4, Jesse Charles. We were talking about the parades that they had before the menstrual show to advertise.

Uh-huh, yeah. Well, like I said before, I played one parade on a public ministry show during that season. And the next season I didn't go back on account of those parades they were making, but a few years later I went back and they had cut the parades out. And the only thing you had to do on that show was to play the showdown. And that was alright because you'd rehearse for three weeks and get the showdown.
